name: Jenkins
label: Jenkins Remote Access API
description: Jenkins Remote Access API. baseUrl is {jenkins_url}. job_create posts config.xml as application/xml; job_build takes token/delay query params. Docs: https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/using/remote-access-api/. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: job_build | job_build_wait | job_get | job_copy | job_create | build_list | queue_get | queue_item_get | quiet_down | restart | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'job_build'.

schema.label: jobPath
schema.description: Job path for build/get/list. Folders: Folder/job/Name. Example: my-job.

schema.label: name
schema.description: New job name query for job_create / job_copy. Example: pipeline-2.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Source job name for job_copy query from. Example: pipeline-1.

schema.label: tree
schema.description: Jenkins tree query for build_list. Example: builds[number,result,timestamp].

schema.label: token
schema.description: Remote-build token query for job_build / job_build_wait. Configure the same token on the job.

schema.label: delay
schema.description: Optional build delay query (Jenkins delay, e.g. 0sec) for job_build / job_build_wait.

schema.label: configXml
schema.description: Job config.xml for job_create. Sent as raw application/xml body. Official Jenkins createItem body.

schema.label: queue_id
schema.description: Queue item id for queue_item_get. Jenkins returns it in the Location header of job_build (/queue/item/<id>/). Example: 1042.

schema.label: jenkins_url
schema.description: Jenkins origin including scheme, no trailing slash. Overrides config. Example: https://ci.example.com.

schema.label: config_xml
schema.description: Job config.xml for job_create. Sent as raw application/xml body (alias of configXml). Official Jenkins createItem body.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: job_build, job_build_wait, job_get, job_copy, job_create, build_list, queue_get, queue_item_get, quiet_down, restart, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Jenkins user API token (not account password). Basic user:token. CSRF crumb is not auto-fetched by OfficialApiNode.

configurationParameters.label: Jenkins URL
configurationParameters.description: Jenkins origin including scheme (baseUrl {jenkins_url}). Example: https://ci.example.com. No trailing slash.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Config Xml
configurationParameters.description: Job config.xml for job_create. Sent as raw application/xml body (alias of configXml). Official Jenkins createItem body.
